services.desc: Masonboro Island is the largest undisturbed barrier island along the southern North Carolina coast and is located right off the coast of Wilmington, North Carolina. The island is part of the Cape Fear Coast and is 24 nautical miles round trip from Carolina Beach. This undeveloped barrier island is only accessible by boat, and its miles of pristine beaches, dunes, and marshes make it a perfect place to relax and enjoy the coast’s natural beauty. A private boat cruise to Masonboro Island is the perfect way to experience all that this barrier island has to offer. The island is hidden in the coastal waterway, has calmer water and wind than the public beach, and is only accessible by boat, making it very secluded.
